-- CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE --

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_ext_table
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(3000),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(3000),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(3000),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(3000),
    Units_Sold VARCHAR(3000),
    Revenue VARCHAR(3000)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = csv_file_format
)

SELECT * FROM revenue_ext_table;
